title: Tail Latency Lattice: per-model & per-route streaming/non-streaming demux dashboard
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a new observability board (Tail Latency Lattice) that decomposes end-to-end request tail latency (p50/p95/p99) by model and route while splitting streaming vs non-streaming IO modes. The goal is to give SREs and platform engineers a fast way to identify whether high tail latency on a route is due to model selection, serving-path (runtime/serialization), streaming token emission, or client-driven request shapes. This ticket covers dashboard design, telemetry enrichment, query authoring in the metrics/log pipeline, and rollout/alerting configuration.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Dashboard surfaces p50/p95/p99 for each (model, route) pair with streaming/non-streaming split. 2) Visualizations include: grouped percentiles, tail violin/box for request-shape cohorts, streaming-token waterfall, and delta-slope trend for tail drift. 3) Traces for high-tail requests are linkable from the panel (trace id available and sampled). 4) Queries run within 10s for 30-day window on prod telemetry. 5) Alerts configured for 95th percentile degradation on any production route (with suppression for planned rollouts). 6) Documentation and runbook updated.
implementation_steps: 1) Instrumentation: add/standardize attributes on request spans (route_id, model_id, io_mode=streaming|sync, token_count_est, request_shape_bucket). 2) Metrics: emit latency_histogram per (route, model, io_mode) and a request_shape label for cohorting. 3) Logs: add structured fields for emit_time, last_token_delay_ms, kv_cache_hit boolean, and pipeline_trace_id. 4) Metrics pipeline: create aggregation jobs to compute p50/p95/p99 and sample tail traces. 5) Dashboard: build panels in Grafana/Console using stored pre-aggregates + click-to-trace links. 6) Alerts and runbook: add SLO monitor and on-call play for tail regressions.
instrumentation_changes:
- Span enrichment: ensure all server spans include route_id, model_id, io_mode, request_shape_bucket
- Add per-request metric tags for streaming_chunk_count and last_token_emit_ms
- Increase adaptive trace sampling for requests with latency > p95 or error=true
- Log pipeline: add grok/json parser rule to extract latency components and pipeline_trace_id
example_queries: PromQL: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_latency_bucket{env="prod", io_mode="streaming"}[5m])) by (le, route_id, model_id))
SQL-like (clickhouse): SELECT route_id, model_id, io_mode, quantileExact(0.99)(latency_ms) FROM request_events WHERE ts >= now()-30d GROUP BY route_id, model_id, io_mode
dashboard_panels: Matrix of percentiles: rows=model_id, cols=route_id, cell shows p50/p95/p99 with streaming vs sync toggle
Tail violin: per-route violin plots (p50..p99) grouped by request_shape_bucket
Streaming waterfall: per-request per-token emission timeline for sampled tail streaming requests
Delta-slope trend: 7d/30d slope of p95 for quick regression detection
Decomposition waterfall: stacked bar showing time spent in (queue, model_compute, token_serialize, network) for p99 cohort
Trace link list: top 50 sampled tail traces for selected cell with trace IDs and first-error markers
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy instrumentation to staging and collect 72h of samples. 2) Validate queries and pre-aggregates on staging (performance and correctness). 3) Roll telemetry changes to canary (10% of traffic) for 48h, monitor overhead. 4) Enable dashboard panels in read-only mode for SREs, gather feedback. 5) Full rollout to prod when canary metrics show <2% CPU overhead and queries meet latency targets.
qa_tests: Synthetic workload that generates heavy streaming tail (long context, many tokens) and verify p99 moves up in dashboard and sampled traces appear
Injected delay experiment: add 200ms sleep in model_compute path for one model and confirm decomposition shows model_compute spike
Backfill test: verify 30-day query returns consistent percentiles with offline batch job
Query load: run concurrent dashboard queries and verify response within 10s for 30-day window
